name: @documind/api
description: DocuMind NestJS application: HTTP API (main.ts) and background worker (worker.ts) entrypoints.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n tsc,http,worker -c gray,blue,green "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/main.js" "node --watch --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/worker.js"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/database/migrate.js latest
scripts.db:rollback: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/database/migrate.js down
scripts.db:reset: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/database/migrate.js reset
